name: Journey to the Steam Planet
author: QuaternionWake
description: Pilot a steam rocket: shoot asteroids and UFOs, dodge deadly steam puffs and collect fuel to reach the next level - but you can't fire while charging the engine.

descriptions.en: Pilot a steam rocket: shoot asteroids and UFOs, dodge deadly steam puffs and collect fuel to reach the next level - but you can't fire while charging the engine.
descriptions.it: Pilota un razzo a vapore: distruggi asteroidi e UFO, evita gli sbuffi di vapore letali e raccogli carburante per avanzare, ma mentre carichi il motore non puoi sparare.
